purpose_context: Scope item B of 4.x rework epic #117. Brownfield grounding found the mission-lifecycle contracts are largely aligned with core already; the real gaps are additive and narrow: MissionReopened and FollowUpRecorded are modelled in Python but have no JSON schema or conformance fixtures, and ReviewerSelfApproval is emitted by core as a lifecycle event but modelled only in the producer_contract subsystem, not the project_lifecycle layer. This mission mirrors core's current shapes INTO the package (never importing core), additively and fail-closed, so every mission-lifecycle event core produces has a committed schema and fixture. Populating LOCAL_ONLY_EVENT_TYPES is excluded (owned by Mission A #118); mirroring SignificanceEvaluated/DecisionTimeoutExpired is deferred pending an operator decision on a RACI actor-shape change.
purpose_tldr: Close the schema+fixture gaps so the mission-lifecycle event contracts this package ships match what core currently emits and consumes.
